ESSENCE: [0] Saṃsāra is unreal for the embodied; bondage never truly is for anyone, so the liberation-rite is false. The error is a fourfold delusion-heap — rope, snake, shadow, ghost. paragraphs.text: Samsara — the whole round of rebirth — is not real for embodied beings like us. Bondage never truly belongs to anyone, so the whole ceremony of getting liberated is based on nothing. The mistake is a heap of four delusions piled together: mistaking a rope for a snake, a shadow for a ghost, and so on.
So the rule has two halves, both negative: abandon nothing, and grasp nothing either. Just live healthy — which means standing in your own nature — and stay as you are.
